independenceStatement: This review was performed independently from generation, implementation, and the other critic roles. Scores are based on the exact archived round-two original, 324 by 405 mobile, feed, carousel, restart-mechanism, and old-versus-new pixels at the declared hashes. Route names, prompts, HTML, and creator intent were not treated as visual evidence.

decisionPolicy.performanceLens: Two-second comprehension, stop power, save or share utility, carousel progression, feed behavior, credibility, and conversion evidence were assessed through the common eight-dimension professional rubric.

reasons: Candidate B produces one dominant claim and one physical consequence, while candidate A distributes attention across a border, label, process cards, paragraph, and action panel.
Candidate B remains comprehensible at feed and mobile scale; candidate A's operational detail collapses before it can create useful proof.
Candidate B turns connected context into a memorable material event, whereas candidate A resembles a clean but familiar consulting information sheet.

strengths: Dark and light fields, image-led anchors, sparse diagrams, and typographic resets create materially better feed pacing than one repeated template.
Localized charged green, dark mineral surfaces, paper fields, and quiet signatures create recognizability without requiring a fixed card shell.
The strongest posts make an operating insight legible at thumbnail scale and retain detail for a second, save-oriented inspection.
risks: Five adjacent diagram-led assets rely on lines, arrows, apertures, or junctions, so the system can drift back toward abstract explainer sameness.
The feed has little current first-party product evidence, customer proof, or measured outcome; it is stronger for awareness and education than for conversion.
The visible footer collision in 08 and clipped label in 10 undermine trust across the suite, even when neighboring tiles are polished.

performanceUse.conversion: weak until current product, customer, and outcome evidence are introduced
performanceUse.seriesPotential: promising but unproven beyond one Field Notes cover and one three-slide carousel

observations: Slide 09 creates the best open loop in the suite by asking for the missing decision before automation begins.
Slide 10 correctly advances from decision to input, boundary, and output, but generic artifacts limit proof and a clipped Arabic fragment is a release-blocking typography failure.
Slide 11 provides a clear trust payoff by making human stop authority visible and memorable.
The three slides vary dark and light fields while preserving numbering, typography, line behavior, and a coherent right-to-left narrative.
carouselSequenceReview.releaseCondition: Re-export slide 10 without the clipped label, make at least one input and the output specific, then repeat current-hash mobile and sequence review.

why: Round two wins the first two seconds through a single claim, physical junction, and quiet support beat.
The legacy composition contains more explicit process detail, but that detail becomes unreadable at the social viewing scale and fragments attention.
Round two creates a message-specific memory structure; the legacy asset can be mistaken for a general consulting process template.
The win is visible in pixels and does not depend on prompts, implementation metadata, or route descriptions.

summary.finding: Round two decisively beats the legacy identical-brief asset and now contains five social-performance-level candidates. The suite is not professionally releasable: two exact-pixel typography failures force rejection, two concepts fail their textless mechanism test, and conversion credibility remains limited by illustrative rather than current first-party proof.

reasons: A role-level professional candidate does not become gold until every required independent critic clears the same current hash with no hard fail and a comparable-or-better anchor verdict.
Candidates 08 and 10 contain exact-pixel hard failures, and candidates 03 and 06 require a concept restart rather than a cosmetic revision.
The feed is ready for controlled benchmark iteration, not production publishing or conversion claims.
priorityOrder: Repair and re-export 08 and 10, then invalidate every critique tied to their current hashes.
Return 03 and 06 to art direction and pass textless mobile mechanism review before rendering new typography.
Polish 01, 05, 07, 09, and 11 without changing their successful hierarchy or core route.
Introduce current first-party product, customer, or outcome evidence before using the system for conversion-oriented publishing.
